name: Can I live in my home during a new room addition construction?

mainEntity.name: Can I live in my home during a new room addition construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Whether you can live in your home during a new room addition depends on the project's scope, the extent of disruption, and safety considerations. Smaller additions that primarily affect an exterior wall or a limited area may allow you to remain in residence. Larger projects involving significant structural work, utility shutdowns, or extensive dust and noise might necessitate temporary relocation. We discuss these practical tradeoffs during the planning phase to help you decide what is feasible and safe.
acceptedAnswer.description: Living in your home during a new room addition depends on the project's scope and disruption; larger projects might require temporary relocation.
